description: This file defines the DivBinary class, a part of Twig's internal representation for binary division expressions in the template syntax. It extends AbstractBinary and implements the operator method to produce a division operator for code compilation.

classes.name:
Twig
ode inary\DivBinary
classes.description: Represents a division binary expression node in Twig's abstract syntax tree, generating the division operator during compilation.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns the division operator '/' as raw output for code compilation.
